caption: The drawing depicts a carved semicircular wooden object featuring a relief of a bird perched among leafy branches. The bird is centrally located, facing right, with its wings closed and feathers clearly defined, and is surrounded by large, elongated leaves and finely detailed fronds. The design is framed by a thin, braided border that follows the curve of the top edge. Below the semicircular section, there is a flat, horizontal wooden base with visible grain texture. The object is rendered in shades of light brown, beige, and gray, suggesting the natural color of the wood, and is set against a plain, off-white background. The artist’s name, John Hall, is inscribed in small, gray uppercase letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Butter Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
